description: Defines the ConfigImportForm class for handling configuration import via a form in Drupal, including file upload, validation, extraction, and error handling.

classes.name: ConfigImportForm
classes.description: A Drupal form class for importing configuration archives, handling file uploads, validation, extraction, and user notifications.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor injecting configuration storage, file system, and settings services.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate the form with services from the container.

methods.name: buildForm
methods.description: Builds the form with file upload and submit button, checks directory writability.

methods.name: validateForm
methods.description: Validates uploaded file, ensuring it is valid and sets form state.

methods.name: submitForm
methods.description: Handles form submission: deletes existing config, extracts uploaded archive, sets permissions, and handles errors.
